headline: Every tub of ice cream checked, not a sample.
label: #FFFFFF
heroLede: With four lines running many flavours and customer brands, the lid, the label and the date are what keep each run right. Here's what a camera check could look like on your tub line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every tub has its lid on, pressed down flat all the way round. A lifted lid lets in frost and comes back as a complaint from the store.
labelLede: A vanilla tub and a choc chip tub look much the same with the lid on, and on a customer brand run the wrong label is their problem as well as yours. The camera checks every tub carries the right label for the flavour inside, straight and intact.
codeLede: The best-before and batch code has to be right and readable on every tub. The system reads the printed code and compares it with the flavour and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Lid offcuts, glove pieces and loose machine parts can end up close to the line. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a carton.
